title: Melchizedek
lead: The priest-king of Salem who blessed Abraham and received a tenth from him (Genesis 14:18–20). Psalm 110 promises a king who is "a priest forever, after the pattern of Melchizedek," and Hebrews reads him as a type of Christ (Hebrews 5–7).

sections.b: Only two other books name him. Psalm 110:4 has God swear to David's lord: "You are a priest forever, after the pattern of Melchizedek." Hebrews builds on both texts: like Melchizedek, Jesus is priest and king, "king of righteousness" and "king of peace," appointed by God's oath and not by descent from Levi, and his priesthood is greater because Abraham, and Levi in him, gave Melchizedek a tenth (Hebrews 5:6–10; 6:20–7:28). Jesus applies Psalm 110 to himself (Mark 12:35–37).
